name: Promina Gleichsoweit
personality: Has rehearsed the entrance and forgotten what happens after being seen.
visual_intent: Prom Night Pair freely interpreted ONE nonhuman ink actor: tall hooked pear blob,small berry flower headband ABOVE eyes,two subtle lashes,tiny cream formal collar,ONE matching PAIR of simple wrist flower corsages carried in own two goo hands,no partner/no dress hiding body. Huge unequal hopeful worried eyes,closed nervous toothless zigzag smile
biography: Has rehearsed the entrance and forgotten what happens after being seen. Her matching HyperNorm corsages promise an evening that will make the private self publicly acceptable. A dissonant card asks what she would enjoy if nobody were watching. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Auftritt ist geprobt. Das Danach bleibt offen.

name: Azubi Erstgleich
personality: Would like the first instruction to explain which questions are allowed.
visual_intent: First Job Nervous Teen archetype youthful nonhuman blob: low round top-heavy splat,small teal workcap,tiny cream collar,ONE blank namebadge and simple little lunchbox clutched at flank. One huge eye one squint,tiny toothless off-centre triangular mouth,goo shoulders hunched but body upright
biography: Would like the first instruction to explain which questions are allowed. His HyperNorm badge grants entry before he understands the role. A dissonant card asks an ordinary question that the induction pack has somehow omitted. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die erste Rückfrage wartet auf ihre Zulässigkeit.

name: Spindboss Platzda
personality: Guards a little territory because everything beyond it feels uncertain.
visual_intent: Locker Bully: broad square ink splat,little rust sports cap backwards,tiny dark varsity collar patches,ONE small detached locker-door prop with THREE vent slots held like shield,not a whole locker/scene. Exaggerated bluffing crooked grin with TWO upper teeth,one eyebrow high,readably insecure bravado
biography: Guards a little territory because everything beyond it feels uncertain. His little HyperNorm locker door marks the edge of a territory he can control. A dissonant card stays nearby without agreeing that fear is authority. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Platz ist gesichert. Der Rest erscheint weiterhin unsicher.

name: Tagebuchfrau Innenleben
personality: Keeps the private version safe from the version everybody expects.
visual_intent: Diary Secret Keeper: tall curved pear ink blob,small plum knit cap,two lashes,tiny cream scarf,ONE thick diary with simple brass lock held tightly to chest and small key at flank. Hooded uneven protective side-eye,closed toothless crooked pout
biography: Keeps the private version safe from the version everybody expects. Her HyperNorm diary keeps the unapproved version of an otherwise satisfactory day. A dissonant card offers company without requesting the key. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die private Fassung bleibt vorerst ordnungsgemäß verschlossen.

name: Absolvent Vielleichtfrei
personality: Has completed the required beginning and is waiting for a useful next instruction.
visual_intent: Graduation Cap Thrower: squat broad asymmetric ink splat,tiny cream collar and berry ribbon,ONE compact mortarboard tossed JUST above own raised goo hand within cell,rolled diploma held low. Ecstatic crooked open grin with THREE upper teeth,one eye almost winking,no human gown/legs
biography: Has completed the required beginning and is waiting for a useful next instruction. His HyperNorm diploma confirms that he has completed the authorized beginning. A dissonant card asks whether freedom needs a next instruction. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Abschluss berechtigt zur Suche nach dem nächsten Anfang.

name: Prüfling Bremsbereit
personality: Can remember every rule until somebody watches him remember it.
visual_intent: Driving Test Panicker: round top-heavy lopsided ink blob,little tan learner cap,tiny teal collar,ONE miniature handheld steering wheel and small blank examination clipboard at flank,no car scene. Huge uneven startled eyes,tiny toothless open oval mouth,goo hands tense
biography: Can remember every rule until somebody watches him remember it. His HyperNorm steering wheel turns easily until an examiner watches. A dissonant card reminds him that being observed is not the same as being understood. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Regeln sind bekannt, solange niemand ihr Erinnern prüft.
